name: James Sloan
bio: a Representative from New Jersey; born in Newton Township, Gloucester County (now Camden County), N.J., October 10, 1748; engaged in agricultural pursuits; assessor of Newton Township for several years; held several other local offices; elected as a Democratic Republican to the Eighth, Ninth, and Tenth Congresses (March 4, 1803-March 3, 1809); was not a candidate for renomination; died on September 7, 1831, in Elmira, N.Y.; interment at a private cemetery in Southport, N.Y.
